description: The context menu for an unlaunched pinned launcher shows only the fixed default entries in the exact order, and right-clicking the dock background selects no item.

assertions.comment: The Dolphin pinned launcher menu follows the source-defined order exactly, from the disabled header through Quit
Because desktop Actions are not parsed, representative jump-list entries do not appear in the default dock menu
Right-clicking a dock background coordinate with no icon keeps hoveredIndex at -1, so no item menu is selected
The four pinned launchers remain after right-clicking the background, with no exception or incorrect item behavior
